exceptions.GET /api/admin/zoho-mail/oauth/authorize: OAuth authorization succeeds by a 307 redirect to the provider with tenant-bound state/cookie; no 2xx branch exists. zoho-oauth.http.test.ts checks Location, state and cookie.
exceptions.GET /api/admin/zoho-mail/oauth/callback: OAuth completion succeeds by a 307 redirect to /admin/email?success=true after storing tenant credentials; no 2xx branch exists. zoho-oauth.http.test.ts checks effects and replay refusal.

GET /api/auth/verify-email.reason: The legacy verification contract always redirects with 307, including /login?verified=true after a consumed token. credential-accounts.http.test.ts checks persisted verification and single use; Better Auth JSON success remains required.

GET /api/auth/owner-account.reason: Owner self-service reads call runtime/owner-account.ts checkSignup and assertSelfServiceOnboardingConfiguration: signup off returns 403 and signup on requires AUTH_MODE=better-auth (503 in legacy). onboarding.http.test.ts exercises the refusal; Better Auth 200 remains required.

POST /api/auth/owner-register.reason: Owner self-service registration calls assertSelfServiceOnboardingConfiguration: signup off returns 403 and signup on requires AUTH_MODE=better-auth (503 in legacy). onboarding.http.test.ts proves configuration refusal without an account or provider call; Better Auth 202 remains required.

POST /api/auth/owner-verification.reason: Owner self-service verification calls runtime/owner-account.ts checkSignup and assertSelfServiceOnboardingConfiguration: signup off returns 403 and signup on requires AUTH_MODE=better-auth (503 in legacy). Better Auth neutral 202 remains required by onboarding.http.test.ts.

GET /api/onboarding/slug-availability.reason: Self-service slug lookup calls platform-jobs.ts checkSignup before the platform read: signup off returns 403 and signup on requires AUTH_MODE=better-auth (503 in legacy). Better Auth availability 200 remains required by onboarding.http.test.ts.

POST /api/onboarding/organizations.reason: Self-service provisioning calls platform-jobs.ts checkSignup before parsing/provisioning: signup off returns 403 and signup on requires AUTH_MODE=better-auth (503 in legacy). Better Auth durable provisioning 201 remains required by onboarding.http.test.ts.

exceptions.GET /api/payments/boleto/[id]/pdf: An authorized issued boleto succeeds by a private 302 redirect to its validated provider document URL and never downloads provider bytes; payment-requests.http.test.ts checks Location and URL refusals.
